summary: Backend-only regression for 6 new features in iteration 39. All 12 new pytest cases PASS and the existing 29-invariant bot regression suite (run_bot_regression.py) still passes. No backend issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5252 lines — should be split into smaller modules (models, auth, conversations, leads, messages, users). File size guideline (>700 lines) is heavily exceeded.

Duplicate-detection matched_field logic in clients_routes.py line 139 uses duplicate.get('email','').lower() == email; if a duplicate matches only by PHONE (e.g. interesado has no email or different email), the label could incorrectly read 'teléfono' which is OK — but if email is empty string AND phone matches, the ternary 'correo if email and ...' correctly falls back to 'teléfono'. Logic is correct, just brittle; consider adding an explicit branch.

send_message inserts message_doc into db.messages BEFORE WhatsApp send result, then raises 502 on failure (line 1916). The agent sees a toast error but a 'failed' message is silently persisted with attended_by_* — by design but verify UI surfaces the 'failed' status badge.
get_next_quote_number seeds counter from max(quote_number) but doc_type filter is {'$ne': 'PO'} — older docs that lack doc_type field will be included (good). Already correctly handled.
Quote model in models_b.py has all fields defaulted, allowing creation with empty client_id / blank items. Consider Pydantic validators to reject blank client_id in production paths.
seed_data_creation: Test fixtures seed and auto-cleanup TEST_ prefixed clients, leads, quotes, conversations and messages via per-class teardown. counters collection is intentionally NOT cleaned up (production sequence preserved).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Endpoints are mounted under /api/quotes-v2/ (NOT /api/quotes/ as the review request stated). The send_message endpoint raises 502 when WhatsApp send fails (no real number), but the message doc IS persisted before — agent message test handles both 200 and 502 status codes. counters._id='quote_number' was already seeded by prior test runs; subsequent runs increment from there. Frontend testing was explicitly skipped per main agent's instruction.
